note: Shoshone NF campground beside Island Lake, a high mountain lake on the Beartooth All-American Highway (US-212), with a boat ramp on the lake. Bear country: food storage required, bear boxes provided. No garbage collection (pack it in, pack it out); fees in cash or check. --Claude
